_comment: Team target decisions for slide placeholder filling (governed by DECISIONS.md and STATUS.md).

genuine_stepup_target_pct.meaning: Target: under [x]% of genuine callers stepped up, per accent group, at a fixed alarm rate. Number 0 to 100.
genuine_stepup_target_pct.comment: Target under 5% per accent group as specified in Deck Promise 66 / STATUS.md.

fairness_gap_points.meaning: Allowed gap in Step-up and Hold rates between accent groups, in percentage points. Number >= 0.
fairness_gap_points.comment: Max 3 percentage point fairness gap across accent groups as specified in Deck Promise 70 / STATUS.md.

bank_retention_policy.meaning: Short text for the 'Kept' cell of the Evidence clip row. Supplied by the bank or the team's agreed assumption.
bank_retention_policy.comment: Governed by Dec8 and Deck Promise 97: 90 days on Held calls, 0 days on Clear.
bank_retention_policy.value: 90 days on Held calls, 0 days on Clear

hinglish_m_rule.meaning: Optional. [M] is clips per speaker. If speakers have unequal counts it stays open unless this is set to "min" (use the smallest count).
hinglish_m_rule.comment: Use minimum count when speaker clip counts differ, consistent with Dec3 dataset floor.
